title: Home Assistant
descript: Home Assistant is a local-first home-automation platform: it connects thousands of devices and services, runs automations and dashboards, and keeps your data on the NAS. This package runs the official Docker Hub image as a non-root container. Internet access is optional; by default it only fetches the alert feed, brand images and Met.no weather. Usage analytics is opt-in and off unless you enable it.
release_note: Rectified per review comments (C10 C2 C3 C8 C9 T1): public repository with complete README, PRIVACY and NOTICE; Apache-2.0 attribution, image digests and trademark notice; privacy policy with endpoint/region disclosure and the opt-in analytics switch; rewritten zh-cn/zh-hk text; upstream image upgraded 2026.5.4 -> 2026.11.3 with a migration note; longer first-start grace so the App Center install no longer reports the app as not openable while it is still initialising.
important: Open http://<NAS-IP>:8107 and create the owner account; the first start can take a few minutes. Configuration, database, logs and backups stay in DockerAppData/homeassistantdocker/ and survive updates. Runs as uid 1000. Needs DockerEngine and about 2 GB RAM; configure a registry mirror if Docker Hub is unreachable. Analytics is off unless you opt in (Settings > System > Analytics). Back up before upgrading: the database migrates and cannot be downgraded. Plain HTTP on the LAN.

zh-cn.descript: Home Assistant 是本地优先的家庭自动化平台：接入数千种设备与服务，运行自动化与仪表盘，数据保存在 NAS 本地。本包以非 root 容器运行官方 Docker Hub 镜像。联网可选，默认仅访问告警源、品牌图标与 Met.no 天气；使用统计为选择加入，未开启时不上报。
zh-cn.important: 打开 http://<NAS-IP>:8107 并创建所有者账号；首次启动可能需要几分钟。配置、数据库、日志与备份保存在 DockerAppData/homeassistantdocker/，升级不丢失。容器以 uid 1000 运行。需要 DockerEngine 与约 2 GB 内存；Docker Hub 不可达时请配置镜像加速。使用统计默认关闭，可在「设置 > 系统 > 分析」开启。升级前请备份：数据库会自动迁移，无法降级。局域网内为 HTTP。
zh-cn.release_note: 按上轮审核意见整改（C10/C2/C3/C8/C9/T1）：仓库公开并补全 README/PRIVACY/NOTICE；补充 Apache-2.0 许可、镜像摘要与商标声明；隐私政策含第三方端点/地区披露与可选的分析开关；重写简中/繁中串稿；上游镜像由 2026.5.4 升级到 2026.11.3 并附迁移说明；延长首次启动宽限，避免安装时被判定无法打开。

zh-hk.descript: Home Assistant 是本地優先的家庭自動化平台：接入數千種裝置與服務，運行自動化與儀表板，資料保存在 NAS 本機。本包以非 root 容器運行官方 Docker Hub 映像。聯網可選，預設僅存取告警來源、品牌圖示與 Met.no 天氣；使用統計為選擇加入，未開啟時不上報。
zh-hk.important: 開啟 http://<NAS-IP>:8107 並建立所有者帳號；首次啟動可能需要數分鐘。設定、資料庫、日誌與備份保存在 DockerAppData/homeassistantdocker/，升級不會遺失。容器以 uid 1000 運行。需要 DockerEngine 與約 2 GB 記憶體；Docker Hub 不可達時請設定映像加速。使用統計預設關閉，可在「設定 > 系統 > 分析」開啟。升級前請備份：資料庫會自動遷移，無法降級。區域網路內為 HTTP。
zh-hk.release_note: 按上輪審核意見整改（C10/C2/C3/C8/C9/T1）：倉庫公開並補齊 README/PRIVACY/NOTICE；補充 Apache-2.0 授權、映像摘要與商標聲明；隱私政策含第三方端點/地區披露與可選的分析開關；重寫簡中/繁中串稿；上游映像由 2026.5.4 升級至 2026.11.3 並附遷移說明；延長首次啟動寬限，避免安裝時被判定無法開啟。
